visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor cafe setting. A middle-aged man with a dark beard in a white thobe gestures '3' with his fingers. A young woman in an orange shirt and white knit beret looks on with a shocked expression. (2) Aerial view of a desert landscape with a highway. The woman is then seen at a terminal with red and black suitcases. (3) Transition to mountainous green terrain with stone buildings. The woman walks across a narrow suspension bridge high above a canyon, followed by a man in sunglasses. (4) Car interior shot. The woman leans out of a moving vehicle window as local people on the roadside wave enthusiastically. (5) Night scene. A woman in a black niqab serves food at an outdoor table. The main character is seen dabbing tears from her eyes inside a car. (6) The woman explores an ancient stone village. She wears a long, black embroidered traditional dress and a decorative headpiece. A man tries on a thick, white woolen cloak in a dimly lit stone room.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic BGM with a strong percussive beat. A high-pitched female voice speaks rapidly in Mandarin with high arousal and excitement. Background chatter and laughter from a male voice are audible. (2) Vocal delivery shifts to a rhythmic narrative style. The sound of high-frequency wind noise is layered over the BGM during outdoor scenic shots. (3) Sound of a car engine running at a moderate pitch. Intermittent shouts of 'Salaam!' and 'Hi guys!' from multiple male voices with high valence. (4) Percussive thud sounds associated with food being placed on a table. Female voice drops in pitch and intensity, exhibiting audible breathiness and sniffling. (5) BGM swells in volume. Sound of footsteps on a hard stone surface. The female voice returns to a bright, clear tone with frequent rising intonations. (6) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition. The music continues as the speaker provides an enthusiastic teaser for the next episode.
